title: Speed up directory listing (max file size)
description: Optimize directory listing performance by implementing max file size filtering
notes: Implemented file size filtering optimization to speed up directory listing. Added a quick file size check before the expensive FFmpeg duration check. Files larger than the estimated maximum size (based on maxDurationSeconds * 10ps bitrate) are skipped without opening them with FFmpeg. This significantly improves performance when scanning directories with many large video files.

title: OBS crashes on shutdown with plugin installed
description: OBS Studio crashes when shutting down with the audio sync plugin installed. This indicates a resource cleanup or lifecycle management issue in the plugin.
notes:
Fixed shutdown crash by disconnecting signal/slot connections from workers to panel before destroying the panel. The issue was that worker threads could emit signals to panel slots after the panel was destroyed during OBS shutdown.

Fix implemented in AudioSyncPanel destructor:
1isconnect all worker->panel signal connections first (prevents workers from emitting to destroyed slots)
2thread->worker deleteLater connections (ensures proper cleanup)
3. Stop threads with quit() and wait()
4. Delete thread objects

This ensures workers cannot communicate with the panel after it's destroyed, preventing the crash.
